'''Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov''', billed as '''The Comeback''', was a [[professional boxing]] match contested between former two-time [[heavyweight]] world champion [[Tyson Fury]] and [[Arslanbek Makhmudov]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-11 |title=Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov odds, prediction: Picks for April 11 fight from proven boxing expert |url=https://www.cbssports.com/boxing/news/tyson-fury-arslanbek-makhmudov-fight-odds-line-start-time-prediction-picks-props-best-bets/ |access-date=2026-04-11 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Fury vs. Makhmudov {{!}} Boxing Event |url=https://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/events/139108-fury-vs-makhmudov |access-date=2026-04-11 |website=Tapology |language=en}}</ref> Fury won by unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ringmagazine.com/news/fury-outboxes-makhmudov-with-ease-sets-up-superfight-vs-joshua-1fEQrU9NEaqRQqOFFHKn3B |title=Fury sets up Battle of Britain vs. Joshua after dominating Makhmudov |work=ringmagazine.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.boxingscene.com/articles/tyson-fury-eases-to-victory-on-ring-return-against-arslanbek-makhmudov |title=Tyson Fury eases to victory on ring return against Arslanbek Makhmudov |work=boxingscene.com}}</ref>

The fight, which streamed live on [[Netflix]], was co-promoted by Gold Star Promotions,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.boxingscene.com/articles/spencer-browns-gold-star-to-be-the-lead-promoter-for-tyson-fury-arslanbek-makhmudov|title= Spencer Brown's Gold Star to be the lead promoter for Tyson Fury-Arslanbek Makhmudov|date=Mar 11, 2026}}</ref> [[Frank Warren (promoter)|Frank Warren]], and [[Zuffa Boxing]] and its  parent company [[Sela (company)|Sela]], in partnership with [[The Ring Magazine|''The Ring'' magazine]]. The fight's co-main event saw [[Conor Benn]]'s Zuffa Boxing debut, defeating [[Regis Prograis]] by unanimous decision.
